regulations.subject: Medical electrical equipment - General requirements for basic safety and essential performance

tests.title: Connection to an external d.c. power source

items.requirement: No HAZARDOUS SITUATION developed when connection with wrong polarity made for ME EQUIPMENT from external d.c. source
items.result: No connection to external d.c. source.

items.requirement: ME EQUIPMENT connected with correct polarity maintained BASIC SAFETY and ESSENTIAL PERFORMANCE
Protective devices that can be reset by anyone without a TOOL returns to NORMAL CONDITION on reset
APPLIED PART specified in ACCOMPANYING DOCUMENTS as suitable for DIRECT CARDIAC APPLICATION is TYPE CF
items.result: Not suitable for direct cardiac application

items.requirement: APPLIED PART provided with a PATIENT CONNECTION intended to deliver electrical energy or an electrophysiological signal to or from PATIENT is TYPE BF or CF APPLIED PART
APPLIED PART not covered by a) or b) is a TYPE B, BF, or CF

tests.title: Limitation of voltage, current or energy
PATIENT CONNECTIONS intended to deliver Current

items.requirement: Limits in 8.4.2 not applied to currents intended to flow through body of PATIENT to produce a physiological effect during NORMAL USE
Currents from, to, or between PATIENT CONNECTIONS did not exceed limits for PATIENT LEAKAGE CURRENT and PATIENT AUXILIARY CURRENT per Tables 3 and 4 when measured according to Clause 8.7.4
LEAKAGE CURRENTS from, to, or between ACCESSIBLE PARTS did not exceed limits for TOUCH CURRENT in Cl. 8.7.3 c) when measured per Clause 8.7.4
Limits specified in b) not applied to parts when probability of connection to PATIENT is negligible in NORMAL USE and OPERATOR is appropriately instructed

sub_items.item: contacts of fuseholders accessible during replacement of fuse
contacts of lampholders accessible after removal of lamp
parts inside an ACCESS COVER that can be opened without a TOOL

items.requirement: Voltage to earth or to other ACCESSIBLE PARTS did not exceed 42.4 V peak a.c. or 60 V d.c. for above parts in NORMAL or single fault condition
Limit of 60 V d.c. applied with no more than 10% peak-to-peak ripple; when ripple larger than specified value, 42.4 V peak limit applied
Energy did not exceed 240 VA for longer than 60 s or stored energy available did not exceed 20 J at a potential of 2 V or more
LEAKAGE CURRENT limits referred to in 8.4.2 b) applied when voltages higher than limits in 8.4.2 c) were present
items.result: Not higher than limits in 8.4.2 c).

items.requirement: Voltage and energy limits specified in c) also applied to internal parts touchable by test pin (Fig 8) and internal parts touchable by 4mm/100mm metal test rod

sub_items.item: internal parts touchable by test pin in Fig 8 inserted through opening in ENCLOSURE
internal parts touchable by metal test rod (diameter 4mm, length 100mm) inserted through any opening on top of ENCLOSURE or adjustment openings
Test pin or test rod inserted through relevant openings with minimal force of no more than 1 N
Test rod inserted through openings for pre-set control adjustment with a force of 10 N
Test repeated with a TOOL specified in instructions for use
Test rod freely and vertically suspended through openings on top of ENCLOSURE

items.requirement: Devices used to de-energize parts when ACCESS COVER opened without a TOOL comply with 8.11.1 for mains isolating switches and remain effective in SINGLE FAULT CONDITION

semantic_fragments.content: The device under test has Type BF applied part. It is not suitable for direct cardiac application. There is no connection to external d.c. source. No fuse holder is used. No lamp holder is used. No accessible connector contacts exist. There are no internal parts touchable by the specified test pins or test rods through enclosure openings.
